messages:
Jules: Heads-up: two external consultants arriving 11:30am tomorrow for a quick setup review. Do they need badges pre-made?
Reception: Pre-made is easiest. Send full names + company and well have temporary badges ready. Walk-ins ok but expect a 2-3 min check-in.
Kiran: Can we also reserve a pairing table near conference C? Theyll need a monitor hookup.
People Ops: Noted. Well reserve 1 pairing table by conf C and add a note for AV. If they need HDMI adaptors, ping eng-infra.
Jules: One of them also wants to ship a tiny kit (camera + mount). Any special labelling we want on the package?
MailRoom: Please address: "Redwood Inference - Front Desk
Attn: Jules (Consultant visit 11:30)
[Office street address]". If weight > 15lb route to Receiving. For fragile items add "Fragile" and include tracking in your message to reception@redwood.com.
BreezeBot: package_alert: FedEx 92G1 expected today 09:40, declared 3lb.
Jules: Perfect. Sending names + tracking now. Also quick question: do guests get temporary printer access?
Reception: No printing by default. If they need printed materials, email reception with files or request a one-time print pass. We can charge to department if needed.
Kiran: Great, thanks. See you tomorrow :wave:
MailRoom: Note added to package log and recipient notified on arrival.
